title: Skeleton Golfer Swing
custom_label_0: Still swinging from the beyond. This skeleton golfer tee is for the die-hard golf addict.
custom_label_1: Comfort Colors Premium Heavyweight Garment-Dyed Tee
description:
The Skeleton Golfer Swing tee — a unique design made for golfers.

Printed on a Comfort Colors 1717 heavyweight tee — 100% ring-spun cotton, garment-dyed for a soft, vintage feel and a relaxed fit that gets better with every wash.

Sizing: This shirt runs relaxed and oversized. Order your usual size for a relaxed look, or size down for a more fitted feel.
